prompt: This is one panel from a painted graphic novel. Produce the SAME painting as a clean widescreen 16:9 frame for animation: remove every speech balloon, caption box, sound-effect word and all lettering, and paint in what was behind them so nothing looks erased. Extend the scene naturally to the left and right to fill the wider frame, continuing the same room, furniture, light and brushwork. Keep every character exactly as painted: same faces, masks, fur, costumes, poses, expressions, props and colours. Keep the painterly, slightly caricatured illustration style with visible brushwork and rich colour; do not make it photographic, do not add halftone dots, do not add a border, do not add any text. Keep the grey-maned ape in the cream coat pushing with both hands on the back of the ape in the steel helmet, who strains against the glowing transparent bubble wall filling the open front doorway. Beyond the bubble wall, outside, is ONLY the sunny cottage garden with bushes and the plumber in blue overalls bending at a pipe; there is no machinery, no laboratory, no pipes or consoles. The room on the left is the same cosy wooden sitting room with bookshelves, lamps and framed pictures.
